method.method_draft: First read the 4 by 4 grid from the image and record the occupied cells: row 1 has kangaroos in columns 1 and 2; row 2 in columns 1, 3, and 4; row 3 in columns 3 and 4; row 4 in column 3. From the text, use the requirement that after moving kangaroos into empty squares, every row and every column must contain exactly two kangaroos, and minimize the number of moved kangaroos. Count current row totals as 2, 3, 2, 1 and column totals as 2, 1, 3, 2. Since the grid is not already valid, at least one kangaroo must move. The only surplus row is row 2 and the only deficient row is row 4; the only surplus column is column 3 and the only deficient column is column 2. Move the kangaroo at row 2, column 3 to the empty square at row 4, column 2. This fixes both the row and column counts, so the least number is 1.
